title: Built-in Garage Door Opener Pairing and Function
summary: Feedback about the G60 garage door opener centers on pairing, programming, control usability, and whether the built-in opener functions reliably, with many examples being requests or descriptions that do not clearly express sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the built-in garage door opener failing to pair or function consistently, confusing or poorly located controls, and frustration that Homelink integration is optional.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention programming requests, pairing uncertainty, limited range, or descriptive comments about button location without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most sampled examples are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a fuller sentiment picture beyond the explicit negative complaints.
Some fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confidence about the exact issue or sentiment in those cases.
The topic combines several related subtopics such as pairing difficulty, range, control placement, and feature availability rather than one single narrowly defined problem.
